Task-binding immutability, raw completion protection, runtime fencing, and CompanyOS validation derive pilot-claimed identity from durable history rather than current claim presence or a mutable pilot flag.
Never-bound and nonpilot tasks remain outside pilot completion validation because they never receive pilot claim history.
Store.init_assurance is schema-only and never synthesizes artifact lifecycle anchors.
The bounded legacy migration preflights content, metadata, audits, principals, and all candidates in one immediate transaction before any anchor insertion.
